description: A GMA Next-Gen SDK custom event adapter that lets publishers serve Silverpush demand through their existing AdMob or Google Ad Manager mediation waterfall. For apps on com.google.android.libraries.ads.mobile.sdk:ads-mobile-sdk; apps on play-services-ads use co.silverpush:silverpush-admob-adapter instead, and an app never depends on both. The console setup is identical for the two, so one ad source serves an app before and after it moves to the Next-Gen SDK. It carries no third-party ad SDK of its own, and the ad units it serves are resolved at runtime from a Silverpush-hosted configuration - inventory can be repointed without an app update. Supports banner, interstitial, rewarded, rewarded interstitial, native and app open formats.
